home.title: Pick a path. Track it. Ship it.
home.subtitle: Twelve learning expeditions drawn from a real, maintained roadmap library. Choose a direction, follow the route, and keep your place.
home.mapCaption: Every roadmap is a route. Follow it from foundations to production.
home.pickerBody: Answer three questions to get a starting recommendation. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
home.goalLabel: What do you want to build?
home.timeLabel: How much time do you have?
home.recommendedBody: Based on your answers, start with {{title}}.
home.featuredBody: Three expeditions are fully mapped with topics, resources and a route you can track.
home.step1Body: Pick a domain and follow a route built from the repository's own structure.
home.step2Body: Open a topic, read the material, and move forward one step at a time.
home.step3Body: Progress is saved in this browser, so you can return tomorrow and carry on.

roadmaps.title: All expeditions
roadmaps.subtitle: Twelve domains, three fully mapped. Every card is built from the repository Markdown.

roadmap.itineraryBody: The complete list of stops on this path.
roadmap.outlineNote: This domain is an outline. Its itinerary is generated from the repository folders.

graph.title: The route
graph.body: Follow the numbered stops from left to right. Completed legs are drawn in; the rest stay dotted.

topic.notesBody: A short record of the route: what comes before, what to read, and where the material lives.
topic.noPrereqs: No prerequisites recorded for this stop.
topic.emptyResources: No links were found for this topic. Use the source material below.
topic.aboutSource: Curated from the open-source roadmap library. Markdown stays the source of truth.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.subtitle: A record of the topics you have completed, kept in this browser only.
progress.emptyBody: Open a roadmap and mark a topic complete to start your route.
progress.localNote: Progress is stored locally. Accounts and sync are not part of this version.
progress.summaryBody: Your completed stops across every expedition.
progress.exportFailed: Clipboard access failed. Use your browser tools to copy the JSON below.
progress.importFailed: That JSON is not a valid StackPath progress file.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find a roadmap, topic or resource across the whole library.
search.placeholder: What do you want to learn?
search.emptyBody: Search by domain, topic or technology.
search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter term or browse the expeditions instead.

about.title: About StackPath
about.body: StackPath turns a large open-source Markdown library into routes you can follow. Content stays in the repository; the site is only a way to navigate it.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.body: Every topic comes from a README in the repository. Fix a link, improve a summary, or add a resource and the generated data updates with it.

errors.notFoundBody: That route does not exist. Try the roadmaps or search for something else.
errors.boundaryTitle: This page could not be drawn
errors.boundaryBody: Something went wrong while rendering. Reload to try again.

meta.siteDescription: Follow real learning paths for frontend, backend, DevOps and more. Pick a route, track progress, keep your place.
